review_target: first 5-page visual build generated from FFF-v1.0

rubric_review.current_strength: Architecture, abstention, tested universe and EUAS rationale are visually clear.
rubric_review.residual_risk: The falsifiable hypothesis is inferable from 'movimento > M2?' but not written as an explicit hypothesis sentence.
rubric_review.fix: Add a one-line hypothesis banner: movement dynamics only matter if they improve on M2 out-of-sample.

rubric_review.current_strength: ARGOS mark and many-eyes visual language are coherent with the sensor/gate architecture.
rubric_review.residual_risk: A reader could see an eye mark without understanding why the name maps to the system.
rubric_review.fix: Add a compact name explanation: guardião de múltiplos olhos = múltiplos sensores quantitativos; não insiders.

rubric_review.current_strength: 69→59→25→6→8+1 reduction, sample size, regularization and no hyperparameter search are exceptionally visible.
rubric_review.residual_risk: The six mechanisms are counted but not named, so a strict evaluator could say the actual model inputs remain abstract.
rubric_review.fix: Name the six mechanisms in economic language: estado condicional, velocidade, fluxo assinado, concentração, persistência direcional, salto/regime.

rubric_review.current_strength: H2 comparison, confidence intervals, temporal robustness and stop-rule consequence are strong and honest.
rubric_review.residual_risk: H1 is only described as 'M2 continuou informativo', which understates one of the frozen positive findings.
rubric_review.fix: Add an explicit qualitative banner: H1 supported in tested sample — PIT Polymarket probability was predictive relative to tested free/public baselines.

rubric_review.current_strength: PIT entry/exit, SPY, costs, sizing, multiplicity, opportunity/trade counts, uncertainty and C0_NO_TRADE are all visible.
rubric_review.residual_risk: No material scoring gap identified; preserve the explicit prohibition on invented financed-portfolio Sharpe/drawdown.
rubric_review.fix: No new metric. Keep page unchanged.

rubric_review.current_strength: The verification loop, human-in-the-loop policy and outcome firewall are visible.
rubric_review.residual_risk: The page can still be read as governance abstraction rather than concrete GenAI contribution because the three selected case studies are not named on-page.
rubric_review.fix: Add three concrete labels: dados/CI reproduzíveis; auditoria outcome-blind de 69 técnicas; preregistro + execução/falsificação determinística.

rubric_review.current_strength: FDA, macro and M&A completion are clearly separated as future study, with EUAS discipline and no alpha promise.
rubric_review.fix: Keep future-work separation and 81/81 sensitivity qualifier.

required_before_final: H1 supported qualitative banner on page 3
Three concrete GenAI case labels on page 5
Regenerate, render and visually inspect all five pages
